title: The model plugin of Gemma 4 checkpoints
description: A decoder whose blocks sit between two RMSNorms each (plain weights), its attention with query, key and value norms at scale 1, sliding-window layers beside full ones of another head shape and rotary table (the full layers' values the key projection's rows where the checkpoint stores no value projection), a GELU-gated MLP, and where the config routes experts a mixture of experts beside the MLP with a router that scores the residual stream; embeddings scaled by the square root of the hidden width, logits capped by a tanh. A finished model plugin: its layout (layout.json) composed by the models core it extends (model-template: the serving contracts, the options) from model techniques.
